stage: Source admission and CPU structural falsification; no GPU campaign registered

source_selection.selection_rule: All three pinned 1M Wikipedia expiration variants; complete original order and scale; no resampling or best-case selection
source_selection.benchmark_distribution: C: generated expiration/replacement decisions, not a production update trace

wiki_metadata.source_grade: A for observed upstream CMS edits only; not vector-service requests
wiki_metadata.first_page: Retained pre-registration reachability probe, before computing dependency statistics
wiki_metadata.admission: Logical repetition and revision-chain checks only; no physical M/F, GPU or service inference

replay_contract.initial_state: Empty, as in the public streaming runner
replay_contract.insert: Append source IDs in source order; reject duplicate live IDs
replay_contract.delete: Swap-delete source IDs in the runner's ascending range order
replay_contract.replace: Stable-ID payload overwrite at its existing row, not invented delete-plus-insert
replay_contract.visibility: Each source runner call returns before the next operation; searches remain barriers. No concurrent observer or distributed atomicity claim
replay_contract.full_state: Maintain every allocated opaque row token including retired rows, owner/position maps and payload versions; compare all touched rows and prove untouched rows unchanged
composition_scopes: at most 512 consecutive deletes inside that same call
replay_contract.singleton_control: Counterfactual stricter per-point visibility only; no same-contract performance comparison
replay_contract.physical_adapter_boundary: Packed swap-delete is our explicit structural adapter, not a claim that the source ANN systems use it

metrics.M: Actual non-self row-copy commands from the declared sequential adapter
metrics.F: Final nonidentity original-source assignments from the frozen generic planner
metrics.batch_distribution: Unweighted p50/p90 of per-batch ratios among M>0, separately from weighted elimination
metrics.dependency_edges: All ordered RAW/WAW/WAR row conflicts, with depth/width of the frozen legal-wave schedule
metrics.source_lifetimes: Source call-step and mutation-step intervals, not fabricated wall-clock arrival/ACK times
metrics.cost_boundary: CPU planning-only diagnostics if performed; never full ACK, device time or events+release

admission.GO_MECHANISM_QUESTION: Requires sourced legal opportunity, quantified same-contract costs and a concrete unresolved nonincremental mechanism contradiction
admission.missing_vector_ACK_or_workload_authority: EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT; retain useful narrow evidence without a real-vector-service conclusion
admission.failure_policy: Preserve input or validation failure; do not silently skip, reorder, relabel or repair a source operation
